delete.description: Deletes one of the caller's resumes once processing has ended. get.description: The resume tailored for this application's job, computed from the candidate's own parsed resume, with a section-by-section view of what changed. It selects and orders the candidate's own bullets and never adds or rewords text. Nothing is stored; the view is recomputed and is bound to the packet by its content hash.

200.description: Owner-scoped tailored resume preview

get.description: One verified PDF rendering of the tailored resume the current packet carries. Generated resumes are delivered only as PDF. It is refused with a stale-packet conflict unless the rendering's content hash equals the packet's resume hash, so the file a candidate downloads is exactly the one they reviewed.

200.description: Owner-scoped tailored resume file

get.description: The candidate's own original uploaded resume in its original format, for the employer attachment. Owner-scoped and bound to the current packet: it is refused with a stale-packet conflict unless the file's SHA-256 equals the packet's resume hash, and with a conflict when the packet carries a generated resume instead. Files above 2 MiB are refused. The response is not cacheable and must not be persisted, logged or placed in a URL.

200.description: Owner-scoped uploaded resume file

get.description: The candidate's own original resume that the current packet's generated resume was made from, in its original format, for comparing the two. Owner-scoped. It is served only while the packet carries a current generated resume (the opposite of the uploaded-resume read, which is refused for such a packet), and the original is found through the generation's own record: the caller cannot name a document. It is refused with a stale-packet conflict when there is no current generated resume, or when the original is gone or has been replaced since the resume was generated. Files above 2 MiB are refused. The response is not cacheable and must not be persisted, logged or placed in a URL.

200.description: Owner-scoped original resume file

get.description: Owner-scoped immutable cover-letter preview. Reading never regenerates text or calls a model. Grounded text still requires review.

200.description: Owner-scoped cover-letter preview

get.description: Verified PDF or DOCX from the packet-bound immutable draft, without regeneration. Refuses absent or stale bindings.

200.description: Owner-scoped cover-letter file

get.description: Polls an owner-scoped durable packet preparation. No prompts, candidate facts or provider response bodies. Success still requires packet review and approval.

200.description: Owner-scoped packet preparation

post.description: Builds a new immutable packet version from confirmed profile evidence and the candidate's explicit entries. Any prior approval is superseded. Explicit coverLetter opt-in returns 202 and an owner-scoped durable operation instead. Replay does not initiate another model call. Live generation is separately default-off.
Approves exactly one packet hash. Every reviewable field, including restricted answers, must be acknowledged.

200.description: Owner-scoped application state

post.description: Drafts a short answer to one free-text employer question from the candidate's confirmed Profile facts and this application's job. The draft is returned once and never stored (ADR-057); the candidate reads and edits it before anything is submitted. Restricted, attestation, signature and challenge questions are declined before any model call.

200.description: A grounded draft, or the reason none was written

post.description: Withdraws a live approval so the candidate can edit; a new packet needs a new approval.

200.description: Owner-scoped application state

post.description: Cancels before any submission is in flight. A confirmed submission cannot be cancelled.

200.description: Owner-scoped application state

post.description: Starts one submission attempt if and only if the approval still matches the live job, form, and artifacts. A changed binding invalidates approval instead of submitting.

200.description: Owner-scoped application state

post.description: Records that the candidate is submitting this application by hand, without any adapter observing a form. The attempt begins taken over; the candidate then reconciles it as submitted or not through the exact same reconciliation route an automated attempt's ambiguous result uses. Refused, the same as a normal submission start, if the live job, resume, or cover letter no longer matches the approved packet; a packet bound to an observed form is treated as changed, since no form is observed here.

200.description: Owner-scoped application state

post.description: Write-ahead record made immediately before the irreversible submit action. It succeeds at most once per attempt.

200.description: Owner-scoped application state

post.description: Records the observed submission result. Any unclear result after dispatch is ambiguous and blocks another submission until reconciled.

200.description: Owner-scoped application state

post.description: Candidate reconciliation of an ambiguous or taken-over attempt. Reporting not-submitted requires acknowledging duplicate-submission risk.

get.description: Default-off scalar-only owner authorization for a native temporary cover-letter process. Authentication and owner resolution use the normal Gateway boundary. No generated body is read, rendered, reconstructed or persisted. An affirmative result is a point-in-time packet proof, not an approval, expiry renewal, process-stop or purge certificate.

The configured origin is derived from owning original allocation metadata, not caller input. No generated body or token is returned. This is point-in-time discovery, not task liveness, renewed expiry or permission to read content; native HTTPS independently authorizes each read.

TooManyRequests.description: Too many requests; try again later

Forbidden.description: The authenticated caller lacks the required scope

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with current resource or idempotency state

PayloadTooLarge.description: The request body exceeds the endpoint limit

UnsupportedMediaType.description: The request body is not JSON

PublicJobBadRequest.description: The anonymous public job request shape is invalid

PublicJobNotFound.description: The public job identifier is absent, inactive, or expired

PublicJobUnavailable.description: Public job detail cannot be read safely

ServiceUnavailable.description: The requested capability is temporarily unavailable

createdAt.description: Database-generated answer creation time, included by the owner-list route. Optional for compatibility with unchanged save responses.

limits.description: Quantities the evaluated plan allows (ADR-032). Billing owns them; the context that owns the limited thing enforces them.

packetAvailability.description: Selected saved-answer bindings are no longer current. Packet and approval are withheld; only metadata is returned for recovery or reconciliation.

matchesPacket.description: True only when the current packet's resume hash equals this live tailoring. False means the resume, the job text, or the tailoring version changed since the packet was prepared.

temporaryMaterial.description: Exact original memory generation and fixed expiry on the native resume path. Do not persist or cache this response; discard platform copies at expiry, logout, cancellation or confirmed submission.

contentSha256.description: Format-independent content hash that the packet's resume hash binds.

temporaryMaterial.description: Exact original memory generation and fixed expiry on the native resume path. Do not persist or cache this response; discard platform copies at expiry, logout, cancellation or confirmed submission.

state.description: not_requested: no generation was asked for the current packet. preparing: queued or running; a cold start typically takes one to two minutes. ready: a generated PDF is available until its fixed expiry. failed: generation ended without a resume or exceeded its bound; request it again. expired: the generated resume passed its fixed 30-minute expiry.

errorCode.description: Present only when state is failed. no_resume: the candidate has no uploaded resume to tailor.

requestedAt.description: When generation was requested for the current packet lineage. Absent when state is not_requested.

ApplicationResumeGeneration.description: Honest, value-free status of the generated resume for the current application packet. Derived from owner metadata only; it never carries content, task identifiers or provider detail.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the original file bytes. Equals the current packet's resume hash.

ApplicationUploadedResumeFile.description: The candidate's own original uploaded resume, byte for byte, in its original format. Files above 2 MiB are refused rather than attached.

ApplicationApplyIntent.description: First-party website-to-extension arming message sent when the candidate presses Apply. It carries identifiers only: no credential, file, answer or URL. The extension reads the packet itself with its own session and derives which resume to use from the packet.

ApplicationApplyIntentReceipt.description: Acknowledges that the extension holds the identifiers in memory until this deadline. Not submission evidence.

ApplicationNativeTransferBegin.description: Default-off first-party website-to-extension transport only; no REST route, credentials or submission authority.

ApplicationNativeTransferAdmission.description: One-use transfer admission, at most 60 seconds and bounded by original material/approval deadlines. Runtime must bind Chrome sender and destination documents plus the current extension account. No token is carried.

ApplicationNativeTransferFile.description: Transient native file with mandatory original generation metadata. Validate the exact resume/cover-letter producer shape by material kind, decoded bytes/hash/format and matching approved packet before use. Never send through Gateway, persist, log or renew expiry.

ApplicationNativeTransferCommit.description: Memory-only cross-client file transfer. Consume the exact admitted nonce before asynchronous validation; enforce aggregate serialized/decoded byte caps and one file per admitted material. A transfer ACK is not an ATS dispatch or confirmation.

ApplicationNativeTransferReceipt.description: Private memory-transfer acknowledgement only. Expiry is the original material/approval minimum, not a renewed file lifetime. No submission-state meaning.

ApplicationNativeTransferDiscard.description: Withdraw the exact retained transfer from its original trusted sender document. Confers no read, replacement, file upload or submission authority.

ApplicationNativeTransferCancel.description: Withdraw an admitted or committing transfer using its exact original sender and nonce, including after a lost acknowledgement. No replacement or ATS authority.

jobId.description: Only this candidate's applications for this job, newest first.

result.description: Immutable prepared-packet reference. Read the application separately for current state, which may change after preparation completes.

revision.description: Application revision when this packet was committed; later changes do not alter it.

temporaryMaterial.description: Exact current memory generation and original fixed expiry. This response must not be persisted or cached; discard platform copies at expiry, logout, cancellation or confirmed submission.

contentSha256.description: Format-independent immutable cover-letter content hash bound to the packet.

temporaryMaterial.description: Exact current memory generation and original fixed expiry. This response must not be persisted or cached; discard platform copies at expiry, logout, cancellation or confirmed submission.

resume.description: generate (default) also requests the one-off generated resume. uploaded builds the packet with the candidate's own uploaded resume and requests no generation.

PrepareApplicationPacketRequest.description: Omit coverLetter for existing synchronous preparation. Explicit opt-in acknowledges the current OpenAI cover-letter notice; acknowledgement time is server-recorded. Clients cannot supply timestamps or provider/model overrides. Generated text always requires candidate review. Saved-answer reuse is default-off; explicit selections confirm exact question meaning/context and require review. No context is inferred.

question.description: The employer's question exactly as the form shows it. Untrusted text.

guidance.description: The employer's help text under the question (length, style). Untrusted text.

StartManualApplicationSubmissionRequest.description: Legacy manual starts carry no form and retain existing invalidation. A form-bound packet requires a fresh candidate-confirmed observed structure; the original 60-second capture lease is checked under admission locks. No raw question text or answer values are accepted. This is candidate attestation, not provider confirmation.

ApplicationTemporaryMaterial.description: Original generated material metadata only. No content or ownership credentials. Expiry is completion plus exactly 1,800,000 milliseconds; access, edits and retries never renew it. Generation identity and deadline are part of the packet approval binding.

ApplicationTemporaryMaterialAuthorizatio.description: Scalar current packet authorization for one original temporary cover letter. Does not carry generated content, tokens or ownership credentials and never extends expiry.

ApplicationTemporaryMaterialLocation.description: Point-in-time original native read location metadata. Not a credential or liveness proof; direct native HTTPS separately authorizes every read. Never carries generated content or renews expiry.

kind.description: uploaded_resume is the candidate's own original file in its original format; generated kinds are temporary and carry their generation ID.

fileName.description: The name the employer page sees, built by the extension from the approved name and the job title.

readiness.description: Asks how many required questions only the candidate can answer are still incomplete on the page, before any attempt exists. Carries the approved answers the page run would use; the page only reads, and answers with a count.

needs.description: Only when readiness was asked: how many required questions only the candidate can answer are not complete yet. A count; never a label or a value.

documentId.description: The browser's own document id for the employer page: 32 hexadecimal characters, or a UUID.

fillOnly.description: Fill the approved answers and attach the files, then stop for the candidate's review. Nothing is submitted.

NotificationItem.description: An in-app action inbox item (ADR-055). A classification and an opaque application reference, never candidate content. Acknowledging or dismissing it never changes the application.

NotificationDeliveryStatus.description: Where this candidate receives notifications. The in-app inbox is always on.

NotificationPreferences.description: Delivery preferences. The in-app inbox cannot be turned off; email is off until the candidate turns it on. Version 0 means defaults that were never saved.
